test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said to me, “Please pass the salt.”

options.text: He requested me to pass the salt.
He requested me that I pass the salt.
He advised me that I should pass the salt.

solution:
The correct answer is "**He requested me to pass the salt"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is affermative sentence and is in **Simple Present Tense**.
 
• Simple Present Tense (Subject + V1 + Object) should be converted into Simple Past Tense (Subject + had + V2 + Object).
 
• The sentence is converted to indirect speech by adding** 'requested' **in place of** 'please'.**
 
• The first form of verb changes to the **second form** of verb while converting to indirect speech.
 
• Example:
 
 
• He said, "I live in Canada". (Direct Speech)
 
• He said that he lived in Canada. (Indirect Speech)
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: *He requested me to pass the salt***.**

The correct answer is **option 2**.
